purpose: Preserve how future governed agents may compare real-world observations with Anthropic Econ Scenario Explorer v1.0 assumptions without converting the external model into a trading signal.

future_sources: task-level autonomy/capability benchmarks with stable definitions
candidate_observation_lanes.join_goal: Track whether observed AI reach, use, autonomy and productivity are moving toward modest/substantial/extreme assumptions.
candidate_observation_lanes.major_risk: Provider-specific Claude usage is not the same as economy-wide AI adoption.

candidate_observation_lanes.join_goal: Test whether AI productivity expansion is accompanied by capital formation and infrastructure deployment consistent with the model's capital channel.
candidate_observation_lanes.major_risk: Market valuation and capex are not interchangeable with measured capital stock or factor income share.

candidate_observation_lanes.join_goal: Observe institutional ownership and concentration around AI/compute/infrastructure beneficiaries as a capital-allocation context layer.
candidate_observation_lanes.major_risk: Ownership concentration does not measure macro capital share and must never be used as a direct proxy.

candidate_observation_lanes.join_goal: Compare observed occupational reallocation, wage divergence and unemployment with scenario paths while preserving publication-time vintages.
candidate_observation_lanes.major_risk: Occupation definitions and exposure taxonomies can drift; vintage-locking is required.

candidate_observation_lanes.join_goal: Measure macro outcomes against the external scenario envelope using vintage-correct data.
candidate_observation_lanes.major_risk: Ex-post revised macro series create look-ahead unless real-time vintages are preserved.

candidate_observation_lanes.join_goal: Track policy, procurement and regulatory conditions that may accelerate or constrain AI diffusion and capital formation.
candidate_observation_lanes.major_risk: Policy events are contextual mechanisms, not scenario parameters themselves.

candidate_observation_lanes.join_goal: Study how capital markets react if economic evidence increasingly resembles a given scenario regime.
candidate_observation_lanes.major_risk: This is downstream market reaction research and must not be used to validate the economic model itself.
